stem: In 1997, Vernon Baker was awarded the Medal of Honor. How was this award historically significant?

options.label: A
options.text: Baker was the first U.S. naval officer to be honored for bravery in combat.

options.label: B
options.text: Baker was the only living African American veteran of World War II ever to receive the medal.

options.label: C
options.text: Baker commanded the first Marine brigade to land at Normandy during World War II.

options.label: D
options.text: Baker was the only recipient to serve in both World War I and World War II.
